content.title: St. Patrick’s Day Parade
content.text: 175th Anniversary CelebrationHappy 250th America — You Are Great The 2026 San Francisco St. Patrick’s Day Parade, held on Saturday, March 14, marks two historic milestones: The 175th Anniversary of San Francisco’s St. Patrick’s Day Parade The 250th Birthday of the United States of America Under the theme “Happy 250th America — You Are Great,” this year’s celebration honors the enduring friendship between Ireland and the United States and celebrates the shared spirit of freedom, opportunity, and civic pride that has shaped both nations. The parade will feature a vibrant procession of floats, marching bands, pipe bands, traditional Irish dancers, cultural organizations, youth groups, and community leaders. For 175 years, this parade has reflected the strength, resilience, and joy of San Francisco’s Irish community and its deep roots in the life of the city. The parade begins at 11:30 AM, marching from 2nd & Market to Civic Center Plaza, drawing spectators from across the Bay Area and beyond. Together, the Parade, Festival, and Youth Sports Day create a full day of celebration honoring 175 years of tradition and America’s 250th birthday — a joyful expression of culture, community, and unity in San Francisco. When: Saturday, March 14th, 2026. Starting at 11:30am.Where: From 2nd & Market to the Civic Center. After the Parade — Civic Center Celebrations Unite SF FestivalBy Sunset Mercantile The Unite SF Festival continues the celebration with: Live Irish music Irish dancing Cultural performances Irish hospitality Food, shopping, and community booths This free public festival offers a lively gathering space for families and friends to celebrate Irish heritage and American pride in the heart of the city. When: 11:00 AM – 5:00 PMWhere: Civic Center Area (Grove & Polk Streets, near City Hall) Youth Sports Day Youth Sports Day highlights traditional Irish and community athletics, including: Irish Football Hurling Camogie Rugby And more Local youth organizations and athletic groups will showcase skills, host demonstrations, and invite young participants to get involved in sport and teamwork. When: 11:00 AM – 4:00 PMWhere: San Francisco Civic Center Plaza Together, the Parade, Festival, and Youth Sports Day create a full day of celebration honoring 175 years of tradition and America’s 250th birthday — a joyful expression of culture, community, and unity in San Francisco.
